            'matching_states': [{'name': s.name, 'status': s.status.value} for s in relevant],
            'absent_names': sorted(NAMES - {s.name for s in relevant}),

        mats.append({'date': day, 'layer': layer, 'storage_id': record.storage_id,
            'run_id': record.event_log_entry.run_id, 'timestamp': record.timestamp,
            'row_count': md['dagster/row_count'].value,
            'source_row_count': md['goldenshare/source_row_count'].value,
            'file_sha256': md['goldenshare/file_sha256'].value,
            'raw_sha256': md['goldenshare/raw_sha256'].value if layer == 'silver' else None})
    for (day, layer), record in sorted(actual['checks'].items()):
        evaluation = record.event.dagster_event.event_specific_data
        target = evaluation.target_materialization_data
        mat = actual['mats'][(day, layer)]
        assert evaluation.metadata['goldenshare/checked_row_count'].value == counts[day]
        assert evaluation.partition == record.partition == day
        assert evaluation.passed and evaluation.blocking and record.status.value == 'SUCCEEDED'
        assert target.storage_id == mat.storage_id and target.run_id == mat.event_log_entry.run_id and target.timestamp == mat.timestamp
        checks.append({'date': day, 'layer': layer, 'status': record.status.value,
            'partition': record.partition, 'checked_row_count': evaluation.metadata['goldenshare/checked_row_count'].value,
            'passed': evaluation.passed, 'blocking': evaluation.blocking,
            'target': {'storage_id': target.storage_id, 'run_id': target.run_id, 'timestamp': target.timestamp},
            'materialization_target_matches': True})
    return {'registered_keys_in_scope': len(set(counts) & actual['registered']),
        'registered_sample_keys': sorted(set(counts) & actual['registered']),
        'all_concept_registered_key_count': len(actual['registered']),
        'materializations': mats, 'checks': checks}

"""Read-only formal definition and pool admission inventory; no mutation."""
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from orchestrator.defs.bootstrap.daily_basic_event_instance import daily_basic_event_instance
query = '''query MoneyflowAdmission { workspaceOrError { __typename ... on Workspace { locationEntries { name loadStatus updatedTimestamp locationOrLoadError { __typename ... on RepositoryLocation { repositories { name jobs { name } sensors { name defaultStatus sensorState { status } } } } } } } } }'''
result = {'as_of_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'formal_writes': 0, 'graphql_query': query, 'endpoint': 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/graphql'}
from sqlalchemy import select, func
from dagster._core.storage.event_log.schema import ConcurrencyLimitsTable, ConcurrencySlotsTable, PendingStepsTable
with daily_basic_event_instance() as instance:
    with instance.event_log_storage.index_connection() as connection:
        limit = connection.execute(select(ConcurrencyLimitsTable.c.limit, ConcurrencyLimitsTable.c.using_default_limit).where(ConcurrencyLimitsTable.c.concurrency_key == 'moneyflow_tushare_writer')).fetchone()
        slots = connection.execute(select(func.count()).select_from(ConcurrencySlotsTable).where(ConcurrencySlotsTable.c.concurrency_key == 'moneyflow_tushare_writer', ConcurrencySlotsTable.c.deleted == False)).scalar_one()
        pending = connection.execute(select(func.count()).select_from(PendingStepsTable).where(PendingStepsTable.c.concurrency_key == 'moneyflow_tushare_writer')).scalar_one()
    result['pool'] = {'name': 'moneyflow_tushare_writer', 'persisted_limit': limit[0] if limit else None, 'using_default_limit': limit[1] if limit else None, 'slot_count': slots, 'pending_records': pending, 'native_metadata_queries': 3}
result['pool_api_note'] = 'Original read-only event adapter intentionally has no run coordinator. Native get_concurrency_info requires coordinator when limit is absent; use three bounded native table reads, do not construct or configure a new instance.'
request = Request(result['endpoint'], data=json.dumps({'query': query}).encode(), headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'})
try:
    with urlopen(request, timeout=10) as response:
        payload = response.read(2 * 1024 * 1024 + 1)
        assert len(payload) <= 2 * 1024 * 1024
    inventory = json.loads(payload)
    assert not inventory.get('errors'), inventory.get('errors')
    workspace = inventory['data']['workspaceOrError']
    result['workspace_type'] = workspace['__typename']
    result['locations'] = []
    for location in workspace.get('locationEntries', []):
        assert len(workspace['locationEntries']) <= 20
        repositories = location['locationOrLoadError'].get('repositories', [])
        item = {k: location[k] for k in ('name', 'loadStatus', 'updatedTimestamp')}
        item['repositories'] = []
        for repository in repositories:
            assert len(repository['jobs']) <= 2000 and len(repository['sensors']) <= 2000
            item['repositories'].append({'name': repository['name'], 'jobs_count': len(repository['jobs']), 'sensors_count': len(repository['sensors']), 'moneyflow_jobs': [j for j in repository['jobs'] if 'moneyflow_cnt_ths' in j['name']], 'moneyflow_sensors': [s for s in repository['sensors'] if 'moneyflow_cnt_ths' in s['name']]})
        result['locations'].append(item)
except Exception as error:
    result['workspace_read_error'] = type(error).__name__ + ': ' + str(error)
Path('/private/tmp/moneyflow-p4-cnt-ths-next-admission-20261012.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
